chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: Recent work: Harlem Blues Band, Cafe Ziegfeld, O'Neal's
summary: He lists the Harlem Blues Band tours in Europe, a long stay at Cafe Ziegfeld in 1980, O'Neal's and the Cockatoo.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Since we're in '70... Do you want to go?
We're in '79. Let's see what's happened since then. What happened between '79 and '83? The last time I was here you were in the Cafe Ziegfield in a big hotel, weren't you.
Yeah, a big (?) hotel. That was '80. Before that I was in... Let me see. The Harlem Blues Band at the Ginger Man. The Harlem Blues Band, they toured Europe.
Did you go to Europe with them?

Yeah, two years ago. I went twice with them. We went to... We did the Breeder(?), and we played at various festivals over there -- in Holland, Belgium, Germany. Lugano; we played the Club 82 there. The Luna(?) Quay(?) in Zurich.
How long did you play at the Cafe Ziegfield?
Well, let me see. I went there... I don't remember exactly when it was.
Did you play there for more than a year?
And what did you do next?

I worked at O'Neal's, opened up the new O'Neal's at 43rd Street after that. And then various club dates, you know; playing different spots. At a place called the Cockatoo; I played there for a couple of months. A salary, I mean...
Then I went to... Of course, the Piccadilly Hotel has been demolished.
